Test_Cases.Title / Scenario: Verify Top AUM Growth card identifies and displays correct advisor using KPI-058 formula
Test_Cases.Preconditions: Dashboard loaded in test env with sample data (multiple advisors, varied YoY growth including negative/zero cases). Gold layer equivalent data available for manual verification.
Test_Cases.Test Steps:
1. Note the advisor with highest calculated growth % from sample data using formula: (Current AUM - Previous AUM) / Previous AUM * 100
2. On dashboard, locate Top AUM Growth card (top section)
3. Verify displayed: Growth % (e.g. 28.5%), Advisor Name, Current AUM (currency format)
4. Confirm it matches the highest value advisor
5. Check default sort places highest first
Test_Cases.Expected Result: Correct top advisor shown with accurate growth % and Current AUM. Values match manual calc from source. Sorted highest first. No calculation errors or wrong advisor selected.
Test_Cases.Comments / Bug Ref / Traceability: KPI-058 | UI Behavior: Show Growth %, Name, Current AUM | Sort: highest value first | AC: KPI cards show correct top advisors

Test_Cases.Title / Scenario: Verify Most Net New Money card calculation (KPI-016) and % vs target display
Test_Cases.Preconditions: Sample data includes advisors with contributions, transfers in/out, distributions, and defined NNM targets.
Test_Cases.Test Steps:
1. Calculate expected NNM = (Contributions + Transfers In) - (Distributions + Transfers Out) for each advisor from test data
2. Identify advisor with highest NNM
3. On card: verify Total NNM value and % vs target (derived: actual/target *100)
4. Confirm tooltip on hover: 'Net inflow excluding market movement'
Test_Cases.Expected Result: Highest NNM advisor displayed correctly. NNM value and % vs target accurate. Tooltip matches spec. Handles negative NNM if present (shows with sign).
Test_Cases.Comments / Bug Ref / Traceability: KPI-016 | Formula exact match | % vs target derived field | Tooltip exact

Test_Cases.Title / Scenario: Verify Best Client Retention card using KPI-020 formula with TTM tag
Test_Cases.Preconditions: Data has Beginning AUM and Outflows per advisor for trailing 12 months period.
Test_Cases.Test Steps:
1. Compute expected retention = (Beginning AUM - Outflows) / Beginning AUM * 100 for advisors
2. Identify highest % advisor
3. Verify card shows e.g. 99.2% with 'trailing 12 months' tag
4. Hover tooltip present with definition
Test_Cases.Expected Result: Highest retention advisor shown with correct % and TTM tag. Calculation matches formula exactly. Graceful handling if Beginning AUM = 0 (N/A or 0%).
Test_Cases.Comments / Bug Ref / Traceability: KPI-020 | Formula: (Begin - Outflows)/Begin *100 | TTM tag | AC: correct top advisors
